payload.description_html:
This section of the Morrison Mural shows what the area may have looked like 150 million years ago.

The Morrison Mural shows what we know about the Morrison environment, based on years of research by paleontologists and geologists. This is just a small section of the mural depicting plant and animal life as we think it might have been during the late Jurassic.
